question: 按客户等级统计 2014 年交易额，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT dc.Tier AS tier, SUM(ft.Quantity * ft.TradePrice) AS total_trade_value FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_customer dc ON ft.SK_CustomerID = dc.SK_CustomerID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2014 GROUP BY dc.Tier ORDER BY total_trade_value DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 交易额 = 数量 × 成交价合计，以货币金额度量
Tier 是客户的分层属性（TPC-DI 客户均为自然人）
统计对象为证券交易事件
